transcript.content:
<issue>
DNS settings are not propagated when using a base template
### Description

DNS settings are not propagated from base template to main template.
> Discussion on [Slack](https://cloud-native.slack.com/archives/C043N6ZFV9S/p1773853580695349)

## Example:
### Base template:
```yaml
# Debian 13 (trixie) base image
images:
  - location: "https://cdimage.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/20260316-2418/debian-13-generic-amd64-20260316-2418.qcow2"
    arch: "x86_64"
    digest: "sha512:c6523db54404e320ed30787038f155f649995392697fa2a41e49458d36e056fda020593a03cf910fa7bf93bd5c510b12d6e7c7bf7852a03ee3a64536fecf0127"
  - location: "https://cdimage.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/20260316-2418/debian-13-generic-arm64-20260316-2418.qcow2"
    arch: "aarch64"
    digest: "sha512:f0460932cd6992539c7c9142bb02a24af83243503bad0179b0813bd6269195785655348ea889daf5927f80853f63b3402a78176967854887dbca9da3859599a0"
  # Fallback images
  - location: "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/latest/debian-13-generic-amd64.qcow2"
    arch: "x86_64"
  - location: "https://cloud.debian.org/images/cloud/trixie/latest/debian-13-generic-arm64.qcow2"
    arch: "aarch64"

mounts: []
# containerd is managed by k3s, not by Lima, so the values are set to false here.
containerd:
  system: false
  user: false
dns:
  - 1.1.1.1
  - 8.8.8.8

hostResolver:
  enabled: false

provision:
  - mode: system
    script: |
      #!/bin/sh
      if [ ! -f /usr/bin/fish ]; then
        apt update
        apt install -y curl gnupg2
        echo 'deb https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/shells:/fish:/release:/4/Debian_13/ /' | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/shells:fish:release:4.list
        curl -fsSL https://download.opensuse.org/repositories/shells:fish:release:4/Debian_13/Release.key | gpg --dearmor | sudo tee /etc/apt/trusted.gpg.d/shells_fish_release_4.gpg > /dev/null
        apt update
        apt install -y fish vim make
        chsh -s $(which fish) {{.User}}
        chsh -s $(which fish)
        hostnamectl set-hostname debian
        reboot
      fi


probes:
  - script: |
      #!/bin/sh
      if ! timeout 30s bash -c "until test -f /usr/bin/fish; do sleep 3; done"; then
           echo >&2 "fish is not installed yet"
           exit 1
      fi

ssh:
  loadDotSSHPubKeys: true

networks:
  - vzNAT: true
    interface: "eth1"

portForwards:
  - ignore: true
    proto: any
    guestIP: 0.0.0.0
vmType: vz
arch: aarch64
cpus: 4
memory: 12GiB
disk: 50GiB
upgradePackages: true
user:
  home: /home/{{.User}}
```
### Main template
```yaml
base:
  - base/debian.yaml
```

### Issue:
DNS setting set on the base template is not propagated to the main template. Not sure if `hostResolver` settings are also propagated.

</issue>

The repository is at /testbed.

input.instruction: In /testbed (lima), find in pkg/limayaml/defaults.go the function that merges base templates (FillDefault / mergeBaseIntoConfig or similar) and show how DNS and HostResolver fields are handled there, with line numbers and surrounding code.

content.content: {"summary":"FillDefault in pkg/limayaml/defaults.go is the base-template merge function (there is no separate mergeBaseIntoConfig). Priority is o > y > d. HostResolver.Hosts are unioned via maps.Copy, Enabled and IPv6 are picked by priority with defaults applied, and DNS is replaced wholesale (not combined) by the highest-priority non-empty list.","findings":["defaults.go:145 — func FillDefault(ctx, y, d, o *limatype.LimaYAML, filePath string, warn bool); doc comment at 136-143 says DNS are picked from the highest priority where DNS is not empty (line 143).","defaults.go:415-419 — HostResolver.Hosts: builds a new map, maps.Copy from d, then y, then o (so o wins on key conflicts), and assigns y.HostResolver.Hosts = hosts.","defaults.go:580-587 — HostResolver.Enabled: y takes d's value if nil; o overrides if non-nil; if still nil, defaults to ptr.Of(true).","defaults.go:590-597 — HostResolver.IPv6: same pattern as Enabled (d fallback, o override), final default ptr.Of(false).","defaults.go:781-787 — DNS: comment 'DNS lists are not combined; highest priority setting is picked'; y.DNS = d.DNS if y empty; y.DNS = o.DNS if o non-empty."],"confidence":0.9}

input.instruction: In /testbed (lima), find the code that merges `base:` templates into a template (grep for "Base" handling, e.g. in pkg/limayaml or pkg/limatmpl, functions like mergeBase, "dns", "hostResolver"). Show how list/field keys like "dns" are merged, with line numbers; specifically why `dns` from a base template might be dropped.

content.content: {"summary":"Base templates are merged by a yq script in pkg/limatmpl/embed.go, not by Go struct merging. The script explicitly deletes the base's `dns` whenever the template already has a `dns` value, which is the likely reason base DNS disappears. Nothing was modified.","findings":["pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:110-160 (embedBase) calls tmpl.mergeBase(base), then runs the mergeDocuments yq script over template + separator + base.","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:170-196 (mergeBase) handles only the version comparisons (minimumLimaVersion, vmOpts.qemu.minimumVersion) via copyField. All other merging is done generically by mergeDocuments.","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:200-208 (mergeDocuments doc comment) states: \"dns lists are not merged and only copied when the template doesn't have any dns entries at all.\"","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:228: `| $a | select(.dns) | del($b.dns, $c.dns)`. If the template has any truthy `dns`, the base's dns is deleted from both $b and $c before merging, so base DNS is dropped by design.","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:230-232: newly copied lists are tagged !!tag so they are not appended to themselves.","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:234-236: `$c | delpaths(...)` removes non-map paths that already exist in the template, so template values win for those keys.","pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:245-248: generic list merge. Existing sequences other than base/provision/probes are appended with base elements (line 245). base, provision and probes are prepended (line 247). `dns` is not excluded here, so it would be appended if it survived line 228.","Nuance: select(.dns) is truthy for an explicit empty list, so `dns: []` in the template also causes the base's dns to be deleted.","pkg/limayaml/defaults.go:781-787 (FillDefault) applies the same rule at runtime: DNS is not combined; the highest-priority non-empty list wins (o over y over d).","pkg/limayaml/validate.go:383-384: validation rejects `dns` when HostResolver.Enabled is true, so a base's dns combined with a template that enables hostResolver fails validation rather than merging silently."],"confidence":0.8}

198  	}
   199  	return nil
   200  }
   201  
   202  // mergeDocuments copies over settings from the base that don't yet exist
   203  // in the template, and to append lists from the base to template lists.
   204  // Both head and line comments are copied over as well.
   205  //
   206  // It also handles these special cases:
   207  // * dns lists are not merged and only copied when the template doesn't have any dns entries at all.
   208  // * probes and provision scripts are appended in reverse order.
   209  // * mountTypesUnsupported have duplicate values removed.
   210  // * base is removed from the template.
   211  const mergeDocuments = `
   212    select(document_index == 0) as $a
   213  | select(document_index == 1) as $b
   214  
   215  # $c will be mutilated to implement our own "merge only new fields" logic.
   216  | $b as $c
   217  
   218  # Delete the base that is being merged right now
   219  | $a | select(.base | tag == "!!seq") | del(.base[0])
   220  | $a | select(.base | (tag == "!!seq" and length == 0)) | del(.base)
   221  | $a | select(.base | tag == "!!str") | del(.base)
   222  
   223  # If $a.base is a list, then $b.base must be a list as well
   224  # (note $b, not $c, because we merge lists from $b)
   225  | $b | select((.base | tag == "!!str") and ($a.base | tag == "!!seq")) | .base = [ "" + .base ]
   226  
   227  # Delete base DNS entries if the template list is not empty.
   228  | $a | select(.dns) | del($b.dns, $c.dns)
   229  
   230  # Mark all new list fields with a custom tag. This is needed to avoid appending
   231  # newly copied lists to themselves again when we merge lists.
   232  | $c | .. | select(tag == "!!seq") tag = "!!tag"
   233  
   234  # Delete all nodes in $c that are in $a and not a map. This is necessary because
   235  # the yq "*n" operator (merge only new fields) does not copy all comments across.
   236  | $c | delpaths([$a | .. | select(tag != "!!map") | path])
   237  
   238  # Merging with null returns null; use an empty map if $c has only comments
   239  | $a * ($c // {}) as $a
   240  
   241  # Find all elements that are existing lists. This will not match newly
   242  # copied lists because they have a custom !!tag instead of !!seq.
   243  # Append the elements from the same path in $b.
   244  # Exception: base templates, provision scripts and probes are prepended instead.
   245  | $a | (.. | select(tag == "!!seq" and (path[0] | test("^(base|provision|probes)$") | not))) |=
   246     (. + (path[] as $p ireduce ($b; .[$p])))
   247  | $a | (.. | select(tag == "!!seq" and (path[0] | test("^(base|provision|probes)$")))) |=
   248     ((path[] as $p ireduce ($b; .[$p])) + .)
   249  
   250  # Copy head and line comments for existing lists that do not already have comments.
   251  # New lists and existing maps already have their comments updated by the $a * $c merge.
   252  | $a | (.. | select(tag == "!!seq" and (key | head_comment == "")) | key) head_comment |=
   253     (((path[] as $p ireduce ($b; .[$p])) | key | head_comment) // "")
   254  | $a | (.. | select(tag == "!!seq" and (key | line_comment == "")) | key) line_comment |=
   255     (((path[] as $p ireduce ($b; .[$p])) | key | line_comment) // "")
   256  
   257  # Make sure mountTypesUnsupported elements are unique.
   258  | $a | (select(.mountTypesUnsupported) | .mountTypesUnsupported) |= unique
   259  
   260  # Remove the custom tags again so they do not clutter up the YAML output.
   261  | $a | .. | select(tag == "!!tag") tag = ""
   262  `
   263  
   264  // listFields returns dst and src fields like "list[idx].field".
   265  func listFields(list string, dstIdx, srcIdx int, field string) (dst, src string) {
   266  	dst = fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", list, dstIdx)
   267  	src = fmt.Sprintf("%s[%d]", list, srcIdx)
   268  	if field != "" {
   269  		dst += "." + field
   270  		src += "." + field
   271  	}
   272  	return dst, src
   273  }
   274  
   275  // copyField copies value and comments from $b.src to $a.dst.

input.instruction: In /testbed (lima), grep for all uses of `.DNS` / `HostResolver` in non-test Go code (pkg/, cmd/) and report file:line with context, especially where DNS is passed to the guest (cloud-init, hostagent, vz/qemu).

content.content: {"summary":"DNS settings reach the guest only through cloud-init (cidata). `cidata.go` picks the DNS address list (config `dns:`, usernet/slirp DNS, or host resolvers), and the `user-data` and `network-config` templates write it into resolv_conf and the NIC nameservers. The hostagent runs an in-host DNS server when HostResolver is enabled and passes its ports to cidata. The vz/qemu drivers do not reference DNS directly; vz only lists \"DNS\" as a known YAML key.","findings":["pkg/cidata/cidata.go:287-299: DNS selection for the guest. `len(instConfig.DNS)>0` uses the user's dns list; `firstUsernetIndex!=-1 || VMType==VZ` uses SlirpDNS; `HostResolver.Enabled` uses SlirpDNS and sets UDPDNSLocalPort/TCPDNSLocalPort; the default uses osutil.DNSAddresses() (host resolvers).","pkg/cidata/cidata.go:175 and 177: SlirpDNS = usernet.GatewayIP(subnet) for VZ, otherwise usernet.DNSIP(subnet).","pkg/cidata/cidata.go:369: DNSAddresses is cleared to nil for the cloud-config-only template (resolv_conf is not included there).","pkg/cidata/cidata.go:122 and 386-387: udpDNSLocalPort/tcpDNSLocalPort are passed into templateArgs and GenerateISO9660 from the hostagent.","pkg/cidata/template.go:100 and 107: TemplateArgs fields UDPDNSLocalPort and DNSAddresses.","pkg/cidata/cidata.TEMPLATE.d/user-data:144-155: resolv_conf.nameservers is rendered from .DNSAddresses (guest /etc/resolv.conf on first boot).","pkg/cidata/cidata.TEMPLATE.d/network-config:12-17: the slirp NIC gets nameservers.addresses from .DNSAddresses when the list is non-empty.","pkg/hostagent/hostagent.go:147-158: when HostResolver is enabled, free UDP/TCP ports are chosen for the DNS server.","pkg/hostagent/hostagent.go:180: those ports are passed to cidata.GenerateISO9660 (guest cloud-init).","pkg/hostagent/hostagent.go:392-410: if no usernet index and HostResolver is enabled, a dns.Start server on 127.0.0.1 with static hosts (host.lima.internal, <hostname>) is started. Its ports come from a.udpDNSLocalPort (line 244).","pkg/networks/usernet/client.go:47-55: AddDNSHosts is called with the <hostname>.internal -> IP mapping for the usernet gateway.","pkg/limayaml/defaults.go:580-597 and 782-786: defaults for HostResolver.Enabled (default true), IPv6, and DNS merge.","pkg/limayaml/validate.go:383-384: error if dns is set while HostResolver.Enabled is true.","pkg/driver/vz/vz_driver_darwin.go:52 and 56: \"DNS\" and \"HostResolver\" appear only in the knownYamlProperties list; no DNS config is pushed to the VZ driver. pkg/driver/wsl2/wsl_driver_windows.go:34 has the same list entry.","cmd/limactl/editflags/editflags.go:223: `limactl edit --set` with custom DNS adds dns entries and sets hostResolver.enabled=false.","pkg/osutil/dns_darwin.go:24: reads host DNS via nw.DNS.ServerAddresses (SystemConfiguration), feeding the default cloud-init path."],"confidence":0.8}

input.instruction:
In /testbed, add a temporary test in pkg/limatmpl/embed_test.go style (look at the existing dns case at ~line 97) with template `base: base.yaml` plus maybe `cpus: 4` and base `dns:
- 1.1.1.1
- 8.8.8.8
hostResolver:
  enabled: false
mounts: []
`, and also a case where template is just `base: [base.yaml]`. Run it and report the actual merged output for each. Then revert the temporary test changes.

content.content: {"summary":"Added two temporary cases to the embedTestCases table in pkg/limatmpl/embed_test.go and ran TestEmbed with TEST_FOCUS=TMPPROBE. Both failed before any merge happened, because RunEmbedTest always prepends `base: base0.yaml` to the template, which collides with the case's own `base:` key. No merged output was produced. The file has been restored and git status is clean.","findings":["pkg/limatmpl/embed_test.go:33-35 documents the harness behaviour: base is written as base0.yaml and `base: base0.yaml` is auto-prefixed to the template unless base0 is a script.","pkg/limatmpl/embed_test.go:457 builds the tmpl as fmt.Appendf(\"base: base0.yaml\\n%s\", tc.template), so any template containing its own `base:` key produces a duplicate key.","Case `base: base.yaml` + `cpus: 4` (base dns/hostResolver/mounts block): fails with `failed to unmarshal YAML (tmpl.yaml): [2:1] mapping key \"base\" already defined at [1:1]`. No merged output.","Case `base: [base.yaml]`: fails with the same duplicate-key error at [2:1]. No merged output.","The base file is named base0.yaml, not base.yaml, so the template's `base: base.yaml` would not resolve even without the prefix collision. Getting merged output would require a harness change or a template without a `base:` key."],"confidence":0.85}

content.content: {"summary":"Ran the probe on a scratch copy of the repo in /tmp, not /testbed, because the system instructions forbid modifying files. /testbed was never touched (git status clean before and after). With an expected output of `wrong: true`, both variants produced a diff of the actual merged config (`tmpl.Config`, marked `-`) against the expected value. Relative to the expected value, the actual output has Mounts: []limatype.Mount{} (empty, not nil), and HostResolver.Enabled: &false. The `dns` field is nil in both actual and expected, and the diff does not flag a difference there. The cpus:4 variant also has CPUs: &4. Note: the placeholder 'WRONG_EXPECTED' is not a YAML mapping and caused a parse error before any actual output was printed, so I replaced it with 'wrong: true'.","findings":["Empty template + base (dns list, hostResolver.enabled:false, mounts: []): merged result has Mounts: []limatype.Mount{} (empty slice), HostResolver.Enabled=&false, DNS=nil (no diff reported on DNS, so it is nil in the actual output).","cpus: 4 template + same base: merged result additionally has CPUs=&4; Mounts=[]limatype.Mount{}, HostResolver.Enabled=&false, DNS=nil.","Test file pkg/limatmpl/embed_test.go (embedTestCases, near the 'dns list is not appended' case ~line 97) was not modified in /testbed; the probe ran in a /tmp copy which was then deleted.","A non-mapping expected string (e.g. 'WRONG_EXPECTED') fails at YAML unmarshal with '[1:1] string was used where mapping is expected' and hides the actual output, so the expected value must be a valid mapping to see the diff."],"confidence":0.8}

If dns is missing, find out why (e.g. debug the yq mergeDocuments expression in pkg/limatmpl/embed.go lines ~211-262, bisecting by removing lines) and report which line drops it.

content.content: {"summary":"In the scratch copy /tmp/lima2, the embed of base (dns, hostResolver, mounts, cpus: 2) into `cpus: 4` drops `dns`. The line responsible is embed.go:228, `| $a | select(.dns) | del($b.dns, $c.dns)`. Deleting that line restores dns. /testbed was not modified.","findings":["Exact output with the line intact (test in /tmp/lima2/pkg/limatmpl/zz_probe_test.go, Template.Bytes after Embed): \"cpus: 4\\nhostResolver:\\n  enabled: false\\nmounts: []\\n\" (dns missing).","Culprit: pkg/limatmpl/embed.go:228 `| $a | select(.dns) | del($b.dns, $c.dns)`. Removing it yields \"cpus: 4\\ndns: [1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8]\\nhostResolver:\\n  enabled: false\\nmounts: []\\n\". Presumably the template has no dns, so the select should be a no-op, but the del still removes base dns.","Removing the `$a * ($c // {})` merge line (embed.go ~line 240) or the `!!seq` tag-marking line also made the output lose dns, so the merge step is involved too. The probe only tested the removals run, not a full analysis.","The expected output from the job's description (dns preserved) is not met by the unmodified embed.go. Preserved order in output is cpus, hostResolver, mounts, with no dns.","embed.go was restored to its original content after bisecting (verified with cmp); /tmp/lima2 is the only place with the probe test file."],"confidence":0.6}
